Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Drake
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/18/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 223 as introduced exempts Touch of Faith Family Services, Inc. from paying any state, county and municipal sales and use taxes which will decrease receipts to the following funds by the following estimated annual amounts, based on information provided by the entity:
Education Trust Fund
($3,120)
County Funds
($1,560)
Municipal Funds
($3,120)
Total
($7,800)
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education
